name: anka-interactive
description: AnkA Interactive website — frontend (Vite + React + Tailwind CSS) and backend (Express + MySQL)
author: Caner Kurt

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
